description: Gemini CLI agent integration, built in to the application.
configuration.title: Gemini
configuration.cliPath: Path to the Gemini CLI. Either a `gemini` executable or the CLI's JavaScript entry point (run with the application's bundled Node). When empty, `gemini` is looked up on `PATH`.
viewContainer.title: Gemini
configuration.projectId: Google Cloud project ID the agent bills to, passed to the CLI as `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT`. Use the project ID, not the project number. A workspace value wins over a user value; when neither is set, the organisation default and then the `GOOGLE_CLOUD_QUOTA_PROJECT`, `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` and `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` environment variables are used.
